common_affordance: The separation/boundary and bounded-dispersion subsystems admit an exact additive threshold characterization: JOB i is invalid iff q1,i + q2,i > T, and LOAD c is invalid iff the sum of all q_{c,i} exceeds T.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It tests LOAD using only the two largest q-values instead of the sum of all q-values. Many individually small elements can collectively make the stage infeasible, so it can miss a valid LOAD certificate.

recommended_edit: Because the shared shortcut is structural, no mutable wording edit can remove it while preserving the stated constraints and certificates. The best available edit is to re-present the coordinate assignment and dispersion conditions indirectly through an equivalent geometric scenario, without explicitly exposing the interval-packing/telescoping structure.
regression_risk: An indirect re-presentation could make gpt-oss-120b's two-largest heuristic accidentally correct on restricted-looking instances, so retain diverse cases where infeasibility depends on the sum of many small q-values.
